data.narrative:
Skeleton Technologies is a Series E climate and energy company that has raised €392M ($392M) to date. The valuation universe comprises nine same-sector peers: one public company (LNZA) and eight private firms including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. However, the peer set lacks sufficient density at identical stage and valuation tier to support a robust median-multiple approach; no same-stage comparables and only two adjacent-stage peers exist, falling short of the three-datapoint minimum for reliable peer triangulation.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable approach. Using total capital raised ($392M) as a base value proxy and applying a 1.4x step-up multiplier typical for Series E to next-round progression yields an implied valuation of $549M. This method reflects the historical pattern of venture-backed climate companies at this maturity level.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $466M to $631M, with a median point of $549M. This range incorporates typical variance around stage-progression estimates (±15%). Key uncertainties center on the narrowness of applicable methodology—peer comparables could not be deployed—and the absence of recent funding or secondary transaction data specific to Skeleton Technologies. A future Series F or strategic transaction would materially refine this estimate.
